fields.label: Surplus Account

fields.description: Cash variances are only postable to accounts (from the shift-closing screen) when the SUM of the absolute shortage/surplus across every payment method in the shift is within this amount. If the combined total exceeds it, posting is unavailable for the whole shift (not just the excess). Leave 0 to disable posting entirely.
fields.label: Max Combined Variance Allowed for Posting

fields.label: Default Purchase Warehouse

fields.label: Default Expense Account

fields.description: Which source to pre-fill the buying price from in Purchase mode. Falls back to the other sources when the chosen one has no rate, so the cashier rarely sees 0.
fields.label: Purchase Price Source

Buying Price List
Last Purchase Rate
Valuation Rate

fields.description: Lock the POS screen after a period of inactivity or when the browser tab loses focus
fields.label: Enable Session Lock

fields.label: Session Lock Timeout (minutes)

fields.description: Manager-controlled capabilities. Changes are recorded in the document version history.
fields.label: Management Feature Flags

fields.description: Allows authorized managers to create item groups, items, and prices inside POS.
fields.label: Enable Catalog Management

fields.label: Enable Purchases

fields.label: Enable Supplier Payments

fields.description: Allows authorized managers to view operational reports inside POS.
fields.label: Enable In-POS Reports

fields.description: Lets the cashier record cash movements from the drawer (expense / receipt / payment) with notes. Entries post a Cash Entry journal linked to the open shift and adjust the expected closing cash.
fields.label: Enable Cash Management (Expenses / Receipts)

fields.description: When cash movements post to the ledger: Immediate (posted on record) or After Approval (recorded as a draft with no ledger impact, posted only when a manager approves it).
